def line_open_words(text):
    ws = []
    for line in text.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            ws.append(line.split()[0].rstrip(',.:'))
    return ws
for name, grp in [('cut', cut), ('finished', finished)]:

        c.update(line_open_words(l['text']))
